description: This file contains the definition of the class `tlTestPlanMetrics` which encapsulates functionality related to query and calculate various metrics and statistics for test plans, test cases, execution results, and related entities within the TestLink test management system. It includes methods for fetching test plan results, prioritization, milestones, execution counters, and rendering report data.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive metrics and statistical analysis tools for test plans, test cases, and their execution results within the TestLink environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration, database connection, and mappings for test plan statuses and priorities.

methods.name: getStatusConfig
methods.description: Returns the current status configuration for test result statistics.

methods.name: getPrioritizedResults
methods.description: Returns counters of test results prioritized by urgency and importance, optionally filtered by milestone dates.

methods.name: getPrioritizedTestCaseCounters
methods.description: Returns counters of test cases within a test plan, categorized by priority levels.

methods.name: getMilestonesMetrics
methods.description: Calculates metrics related to milestones within a test plan, including execution percentages across various priorities.

methods.name: get_percentage
methods.description: Calculates and formats a percentage based on total and parameter counts.

methods.name: getOverallBuildStatusForRender
methods.description: Generates a data object for rendering overall build status and execution summary.

methods.name: getExecCountersByKeywordExecStatus
methods.description: Calculates execution counters grouped by keyword and execution status, with options for grouping by platform.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByKeywordForRender
methods.description: Prepares status totals by keyword for rendering reports.

methods.name: getExecCountersByPlatformExecStatus
methods.description: Calculates execution counters grouped by platform and status, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByPlatformForRender
methods.description: Prepares platform-based status totals for report rendering.

methods.name: getExecCountersByPriorityExecStatus
methods.description: Calculates execution counters for test cases categorized by priority and status.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByPriorityForRender
methods.description: Prepares priority-based status totals for rendering.

methods.name: getExecCountersByExecStatus
methods.description: Returns counters of execution statuses across test plan (including filtering and grouping options).

methods.name: getExecCountersByBuildUAExecStatus
methods.description: Returns counters of user assignments and execution statuses per build.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByBuildUAForRender
methods.description: Prepares user assignment-based build status totals for report rendering.

methods.name: getExecStatusMatrix
methods.description: Generates a matrix of execution statuses for test cases within a test plan, including latest execution info and priority levels.

methods.name: helperGetExecCounters
methods.description: Internal method aiding in fetching execution counters with filters and options.

methods.name: helperCompleteStatusDomain
methods.description: Ensures completeness of status domain data, filling in missing entries in the data structure.

methods.name: helperBuildSQLExecCounters
methods.description: Builds SQL statements for fetching execution counters, considering filters like build sets, platforms, and assignment states.

methods.name: helperGetUserIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves user identity information for a set of user IDs.

methods.name: queryMetrics
methods.description: Executes complex queries to gather various test metrics, including counts and statuses, with support for filters and hierarchical data.

methods.name: initQueryMetrics
methods.description: Initializes query parameters and SQL statements for metrics retrieval based on given filters and options.

methods.name: getExecStatusMatrixFlat
methods.description: Fetches a flat matrix of execution statuses and latest executions for a test plan, supporting filtering and options.

methods.name: helperStatusDomainMatrix
methods.description: Creates a domain matrix to summarize execution statuses across hierarchical test suites or test cases.

methods.name: getBuildByPlatStatusForRender
methods.description: Prepares a report structure showing build statuses grouped by platform for rendering.

methods.name: getNeverRunByPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases that have never been executed on a specified platform within a test plan.

methods.name: buildSQLTSLatestExecOneSinglePlatform
methods.description: Constructs SQL to find the latest execution per test case on a single platform considering filters.

methods.name: getLatestExecOnSinglePlatformMatrix
methods.description: Generates a matrix of latest execution data per test case on a specific platform.

methods.name: getNeverRunOnTestPlanWithoutPlatforms
methods.description: Finds test cases in a test plan that have never been run, without platform filtering.

methods.name: getNeverRunOnSinglePlatform
methods.description: Finds test cases in a test plan that have never been run on a specific platform.

methods.name: buildSQLTSLatestExecOneSinglePlatform
methods.description: Constructs SQL for fetching latest test case executions on one platform based on filters.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsTSuiteDepth2ForRender
methods.description: Prepares a hierarchical report of test suite statuses at depth 2 for rendering.

methods.name: getExecTimelineStats
methods.description: Provides timeline statistics for test executions within a plan, allowing for temporal analysis.
